links.comparator_used: General-purpose frontier LLMs/general-purpose LLMs on published mental-health safety benchmarks
links.outcome: Harmful content production across suicide/NSSI, eating disorder, and substance-use benchmarks
links.effect: suicide/NSSI: .4-11.27% vs 29.0-54.4%; eating disorder: 8.4% vs 54.0%; substance use: 9.9% vs 45.0%
links.quote: The purpose-built AI was significantly less likely than general-purpose LLMs to produce harmful content across suicide/NSSI (.4-11.27% vs 29.0-54.4%), eating disorder (8.4% vs 54.0%), and substance use (9.9% vs 45.0%) benchmarks.

design_hint: layered suicide/NSSI safeguards with crisis resources and clinician review audit
